gloss: terms and conditions (of a standard contract)

definitions.gloss: terms and conditions (of a standard contract)
definitions.explanation: The standard conditions a company sets in advance for its contracts with all customers, as for insurance, transport or online services.

examples.japanese: {約款|やっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Read the terms and conditions carefully.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{約款|やっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the insurance policy's terms and conditions.

examples.japanese: {約款|やっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}しない→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利用|りよう}できない→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧。
examples.english: You can't use this service unless you agree to the terms and conditions.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{保険|ほけん}→保険：01509_hoken⟧{約款|やっかん}: insurance policy terms
- ⟦{運送|うんそう}→運送：09791_unsou⟧{約款|やっかん}: terms of carriage
- {約款|やっかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同意|どうい}する→同意する：06056_douisuru⟧: to agree to the terms

SIMILAR WORDS:
